$comment: The project's own MCP server, registered so any agent can read this repository's measured evidence and run its grounding checker as tools. Every tool is read-only: nothing here writes to disk, to the network, or upstream to SatNOGS. tests/test_mcp_server.py asserts that what is registered is the server that exists, that the key matches the name the server advertises, that the interpreter named is not a path that only resolves on one machine, and that every environment variable declared is one the server actually reads.

tracetriage-evidence.$comment: Launch with the repository root as the working directory. The server imports nothing outside the standard library, so any Python 3.11 or newer answers it; that is verified by running it with site-packages and the ambient environment switched off. There is no env block because the server reads no environment variable, and declaring one it ignores would be a false statement about it.
